author: Cainiac87
body: The Exact Chance of Pale Dragon appearing is directly reverse proportional to how much you need him.

author: Gragnon1
body: I had 10 Level 10 Beastiaries going at one time. I didn't see a Pale Dragon for 38 days. Before that when I had a Pale Dragon in my shops when I was Tier 7 it was 93 days. I couldn't purchase it at the time because my level was too low.  I would have to say it's roughly around 1%-2% chance, also due to some Beastiaries never having any Tier 8 mobs on some days.

author: dr4kun
body:
It's in the 'masterforged' rarity, and one of the most elusive pets in the game.

Finding one in two bestiaries over a week would be very, very lucky. Go for 15+ level 10 pet shops and observe them daily, the pet is worth it.
